  SELECT rid, lid, '' FROM rules
  UNION ALL

WITH RECURSIVE
setting(id) AS (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE ("key" = ? OR name = ?) AND trash = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),
rules(rid, lid, db_content, type_id) AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.left_id, r.db_content, r.type_id FROM cards r
  WHERE r.trash = 0 AND r.right_id = (SELECT id FROM setting)),
up(rid, cur, suffix) AS (
  SELECT rid, lid, '' FROM rules
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.rid, c.left_id, '+' || COALESCE(rk."key", '') || u.suffix
  FROM up u JOIN cards c ON c.id = u.cur JOIN cards rk ON rk.id = c.right_id
  WHERE c.left_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(b."key", '') || u.suffix <> ''
         THEN COALESCE(b."key", '') || u.suffix || '+' || st."key" ELSE NULL END AS composed_key,
  rules.db_content AS db_content, rules.type_id AS rule_type_id
FROM up u
JOIN cards b ON b.id = u.cur AND b.left_id IS NULL AND b.right_id IS NULL
JOIN rules ON rules.rid = u.rid
JOIN cards st ON st.id = (SELECT id FROM setting)
ORDER BY rules.rid
